claims.text:
12. mmr-diverse-retrieval

Target / packet: ai-mmr-diverse-retrieval · R2. Prerequisites: ai:retrieval-top-k, ai:submodular-coverage-gains.

Nearest / distinct payoff: submodular-coverage-gains → ai-submodular-coverage-gains. Set coverage diminishes by overlap; this uses a relevance-minus-maximum-redundancy reranking rule and does not borrow coverage-greedy guarantees.

Finite primary model: Select 2 docs, initial winner A relevance.9, B.85, C.7. Similarity to A: B.95, C.1. Remaining MMR=lambdarelevance-(1-lambda)max similarity to selected. lambda=.5: B-.05, C.3 → choose C; lambda=.9: B.67, C.62 → choose B.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Duplicate penalty 0 reduces top-k relevance. These are declared relevances/similarities and greedy reranking, not a guaranteed submodular optimum or a measure of real human usefulness.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict second selection at lambda=.5; recall whether raising lambda preserves diversity in this example.

Required observable evidence: Keep selected set, redundancy and scores visible; do not rename a set coverage greedy lesson.
